column1: # Format: ruleId TAB action TAB evidence TAB parameter TAB other
# 10035 – Strict-Transport-Security header not set: suppress for non-HTTPS targets
# 10036 – Server leaks information via X-Powered-By: we remove it
# 10037 – Server leaks version information: handled by SecurityHeadersMiddleware
# 10049 – Storable and Cacheable Content: we set Cache-Control: no-store on all responses
# 10054 – Cookie without SameSite Attribute: API uses bearer tokens, not cookies
# 10055 – CSP Scanner: treat CSP issues as warnings only
# 10096 – Timestamp Disclosure: already removed via SecurityHeadersMiddleware
# 40012 – Cross-Site Request Forgery: handled by strict CORS + bearer-only auth
# 90001 – Charset Mismatch (Header vs Meta): API returns JSON, no HTML
